core_loop.evidence: Playtest x3: collect -> upgrade -> rebirth loop works; after 20 min nothing new happens (no new verbs, only bigger numbers).

onboarding.evidence: Fresh join: no objective on screen, first reward after ~2.5 min; Creator Hub funnel shows 41% leave before step 2.

progression.evidence: Rebirths and a saved upgrade tree exist; day-1 retention 14%, day-7 2% (below the ~20% / ~5% rule of thumb).

ux_mobile.evidence: Emulator 360x640: shop button sits under the jump button, 3 labels clipped; all text hard-coded English.

polish.evidence: Cohesive low-poly style and music; no hit/purchase feedback, no animations on collectors.

content.evidence: Items live in a data table (24 entries) so adding content is cheap; only one map and no event so far.

monetization.evidence: 2 passes + 3 products, one idempotent ProcessReceipt, prices read from MarketplaceService, free path to everything.

stability.evidence: scan_luau.py: 0 high / 1 medium (unrated remote, Shop.server.luau:88); session-locked saves; not measured on a low-end phone.

strengths: Clean monetization that does not gate content behind Robux.
Data-driven item table makes new content a same-day task.
